description: This file defines a MATLAB function 'cumsummat' that constructs a Chebyshev integration matrix, along with helper functions 'cp2cdm' and 'cd2cpm'. It includes implementation details, comments, and licensing information.

methods.name: cumsummat
methods.description: Constructs a Chebyshev integration matrix mapping function values at N Chebyshev points to integral values of the interpolating polynomial.

methods.name: cp2cdm
methods.description: Computes Chebyshev polynomial values at Chebyshev nodes.

methods.name: cd2cpm
methods.description: Computes a DFT-based matrix for Chebyshev polynomial coefficients.
